description: When a thread exposes native frames but no Python frames and native rendering is requested, the native stack lists directly while the status bracket is derived from recognized native symbols: a lock-acquire routine marks the thread as waiting for the lock, a lock-release routine as dropping it, and a collection routine as collecting garbage.

cases.expected_output:
Traceback for thread 3 [Waiting for the GIL] (most recent call last):
    (C) File "n1.c", line 1, in native_function1 (library.so)
    (C) File "ceval_gil.h", line 224, in take_gil (library.so)

Traceback for thread 3 [Dropping the GIL] (most recent call last):
    (C) File "n1.c", line 1, in native_function1 (library.so)
    (C) File "ceval_gil.h", line 180, in drop_gil (library.so)

Traceback for thread 3 [Garbage collecting] (most recent call last):
    (C) File "n1.c", line 1, in native_function1 (library.so)
    (C) File "gcmodule.c", line 1300, in gc_collect (library.so)
